p: A wide banner illustration in exactly the style of the first reference image (hand-inked coral-red, pink and cream line work on near-black), but calm and dreamy instead of stormy. The subject is a soft, billowing cumulus cloud floating peacefully, drawn with gentle rounded curves and delicate cross-hatched shading, lit softly from within with a warm pink glow, centred in the picture. Around it, the swirls of the reference become slow, airy wisps and soft drifting cloud ribbons, with a few tiny scattered dots like distant stars. No lightning, no rain, no storm, no dark heavy clouds. No circles with marks inside them, no shapes that look like letters, digits or symbols. No text, letters, numbers or logos anywhere.
